title: Freeway Entrance: Match Traffic and Merge Into a Safe Gap
handbookSource: California Driver’s Handbook · Section 6 · Merging and Exiting. https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/handbook/california-driver-handbook/navigating-the-roads/ (checked 2026-10-15; final human review pending)
learnerPrompt: A gap is behind the blue car. How do you merge?

choices.label: Stop and wait on the ramp

safeOutcome: You match traffic speed, signal, check, and enter behind blue without taking its space.
unsafeOutcome: Stopping in an available merge gap created a rear-end risk. Match traffic speed and merge when clear.
